title: Residue Tor amplitude gives the endpoint Roos epimorphism
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A$ a commutative ring and $J\subset A$ an ideal. On the coefficient-sized model of its pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data], use constant coefficients [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and their derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $N\in D(\underline A)$, let $U_n$ be the underlying $A$-object of $N\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A/J^{n+1}$, and let $t_n:U_{n+1}\to U_n$ be precisely the normalized transitions of [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data]. Assume the product $P=\prod_n U_n$ exists, and define $s:P\to P$ by $\pi_n s=t_n\pi_{n+1}$. Let $a,b\in\mathbf Z$ and suppose the residue reduction $N\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A/J$ has Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. Then $H^b(1-s):H^b(P)\to H^b(P)$ is an epimorphism of $\underline A$-module sheaves. Neither completeness of $N$ nor bounds on its higher reductions are assumed.

source.place: Tag 09C2, lemma-describe-constructible-complexes, proof of (1), surjectivity of H^b(K_(n+1)) to H^b(K_n); sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 0947, proposition-enough-weakly-contractibles (6)-(7).

proof.text: Apply the normalized flat tensor short exact presentation [lem-sfb-adic-finite-transition-tensor-sequence] to every successor transition. Test the supplied residue Tor amplitude [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude] on its residue K-flat representative P and its residue module M at degree b+1. This test vanishes; scalar restriction preserves zero objects and the kernel homology isomorphism therefore makes H^(b+1)(S.X1) vanish. Exactness at H^b(S.X3) in the cochain long exact sequence [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-homology-long-exact] makes H^b(S.g) epic. The natural factorization of derived homology through Q and the normalized transition square transport this epimorphy to precisely H^b(adicFiniteTransition). This is the complete private proof top_transition_epi.

Transport the coefficient-sized model ring sheaf to the actual pro-etale site along AsSmall.equiv and form the inverse sequence with the mapped successor arrows. Apply the existing epimorphic-tower theorem [det-pe-milnor-epimorphic] to this sequence. The module-sheaf equivalence is additive and preserves products. The private map_roos proof, by product projection extensionality and additivity, states E(1-shift) followed by the product comparison equals the product comparison followed by 1-mappedShift. Its comparison is invertible, and the equivalence reflects epimorphisms. Thus 1-shift is epic for every epimorphic tower on the coefficient-sized model. This is model_tower_epi.

Transport exact countable products [det-pe-products-exact] through the same module-sheaf equivalence, as in model_exact_products. Exact countable products imply preservation of countable derived products by homology [lem-weil-derived-limit-products-core]. Apply model_tower_epi to the degree-b homology tower using top_transition_epi. Apply map_roos once more, now to the derived homology functor. Its product comparison is invertible. Epimorphy of 1-shift on the homology product therefore implies epimorphy of H^b of the original normalized Roos endomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09C2 (1) and sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0947 (4)-(7). K2 implements all Tor-test/long-exact-sequence, site-equivalence, product-comparison and epimorphic-tower glue in Lean; only the structural flat tensor transition sequence is isolated.

mathlib_searches.query: For a sheaf complex with residue Tor amplitude at most b the quotient reduction transitions on degree b cohomology are epimorphisms
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: epimorphy of complex components, homology projections, and truncation projections; no Tor-amplitude criterion for quotient transitions.

mathlib_searches.query: The Roos map one minus shift on the product of an epimorphic tower of module sheaves is an epimorphism
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: LightCondensed product and limit epimorphisms, SequentialProduct.functorMap_epi, coherent-topology limit projections, and sheaf generating sections; no result for the normalized pro-etale reduction tower.

from.place: Proof invocation of finite Tor dimension and the underlying limit of reductions; the degree-b endpoint step of the Stacks 09C2 argument used by AdicFiniteCompletionBounds.

lean.statement:
theorem adicFiniteTop_roos_epi
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (N : adicFiniteAmbient.{u, v} X A)
    [HasProduct (adicFiniteUnderlying.{u, v} X J N)]
    (a b : ℤ)
    (hTor : HasCoefficientProEtaleTorAmplitude.{u, v} X (adicFiniteCoeff J 0)
      (adicFiniteReduction.{u, v} X J N 0) a b) :
    Epi ((coefficientModelCohomology
      (constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A) b).map
        (towerTransitionEndomorphism (adicFiniteTransition.{u, v} X J N)))
